# Rei Nuttanon

> Senior Full-Stack Engineer. AI-governance architecture: I design how a team of AI agents works in parallel to ship production software.

Senior full-stack engineer based in Bangkok, Thailand (UTC+7). Building software professionally since 2011, and remote since 2020. Nearly 9 years in online payments and e-commerce. Since 2025, an independent software and business consultant.
